narrative.overview:
A forest-ink bar, a white canvas and fog work panels: the page answers first, then hands the visitor a working map and charts to check the answer. The product mode is **Operate / Read**, not Persuade: a map, time series and a prediction-vs-aforo comparison that people read carefully. Precision and restraint over spectacle. One honest sentence leads the page; everything else is data.

The world is the moss palette of the reference, made quieter. Surfaces are flat and separated by hairlines; the only lift belongs to panels that float over the map. Lime is scarce on purpose: it marks the one active choice (the campaign) and the campaign's place in every chart. Inter carries everything, with tabular numbers wherever a value can be compared.
keyCharacteristics: Verdict band first (question, answer, forecast vs aforo, error vs baseline), workbench second.
Forest-ink top bar; lime only for the active campaign and its highlight.
Flat white and fog surfaces, 1px hairline rules, one floating shadow.
Single-hue sequential ramps (moss for NDVI, water blue for NDMI), never a rainbow.
Colour never carries meaning alone: line style, marker, hatch or label always backs it up.

rules.name: The One Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime marks one thing per view: the active campaign. The selector is lime, and the same campaign is highlighted in lime (30 % opacity) in the province chart, with its own legend entry. No other control or text is lime.

rules.name: The Official Blue Rule
rules.body: Signal blue belongs to the Junta's aforo and to links. OlivEye's own numbers are spruce; nothing of ours is ever blue.

rules.name: The Same Colour, Same Value Rule
rules.body: Map classes are quantile breaks computed once over **all campaigns**, so a colour means the same index value in every year. Missing data is always fog.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that sits next to another number uses tabular figures and carries its unit ("392 kt", "44 %").

rules.name: The Only Floaters Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to panels that sit over the map. Everything in the page flow is flat. No gradients, no glassmorphism, no glows.

dos: **Do** keep lime to the active campaign and its highlight (One Lime Rule).
**Do** pair every colour encoding with a line style, marker, hatch or label.
**Do** compute map breaks over all campaigns and paint missing data fog.
**Do** show every metric with its baseline and validation scheme.
**Do** use tabular numbers with units for anything comparable.
**Do** state source and date under every chart.
donts: **Don't** use lime for body text or for more than one thing per view.
**Don't** colour OlivEye's own numbers signal blue.
**Don't** use rainbow/jet colour maps for NDVI or NDMI.
**Don't** add shadows to in-flow surfaces, or gradients, glassmorphism or glows.
**Don't** make the top bar sticky on phones.
